items.good: I am a middle school student.
bad: I is a middle school student.
I are a middle school student.
I be a middle school student.
items.rule: 주어가 I일 때 be동사는 항상 am을 써요.

items.good: Your new teacher is from Canada.
bad: Your new teacher are from Canada.
Your new teacher am from Canada.
Your new teacher be from Canada.
items.rule: 주어가 한 명(단수)이면 is를 써요. 'be from'은 '~ 출신이다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.good: We are good friends.
bad: We is good friends.
We am good friends.
We be good friends.
items.rule: 주어 we, you, they에는 are를 써요.

items.good: The children are in the library.
bad: The children is in the library.
The children am in the library.
The children be in the library.
items.rule: children은 child의 복수형이라서 be동사는 are를 써요.

items.good: Tom and Jisu are classmates.
bad: Tom and Jisu is classmates.
Tom and Jisu am classmates.
Tom and Jisu be classmates.
items.rule: A and B처럼 두 명 이상이 주어이면 복수로 보아 are를 써요.

items.good: Everyone in my family is healthy.
bad: Everyone in my family are healthy.
Everyone in my family am healthy.
Everyone in my family be healthy.
items.rule: everyone은 '모든 사람'이지만 단수로 취급해서 is를 써요.

items.good: My father is an engineer.
bad: My father is engineer.
My father is a engineer.
My father are an engineer.
items.rule: 직업을 말할 때는 be동사 뒤에 a/an을 붙여요. engineer는 모음 소리로 시작하므로 an을 써요.

items.good: These shoes are too small for me.
bad: These shoes is too small for me.
These shoes am too small for me.
These shoes be too small for me.

cz.st: These shoes ___ too small for me.

items.rule: shoes는 복수 명사이므로 be동사는 are를 써요.

items.good: That is not my umbrella.
bad: That not is my umbrella.
That is no my umbrella.
That are not my umbrella.
items.rule: be동사의 부정문은 be동사 뒤에 not을 붙여요. that에는 is를 써요.

items.good: I am not hungry now.
bad: I not am hungry now.
I am no hungry now.
I don't am hungry now.
items.rule: be동사 부정문은 'be동사 + not' 순서예요. 형용사 앞에 no를 쓰지 않아요.

items.good: They aren't at home today.
bad: They isn't at home today.
They don't at home today.
They not are at home today.
items.rule: are not의 줄임말은 aren't이고 주어 they에 알맞아요. 일반동사의 don't는 be동사 문장에 쓰지 않아요.

items.good: She isn't a nurse; she is a doctor.
bad: She aren't a nurse; she is a doctor.
She isn't a nurse; she are a doctor.
She don't be a nurse; she is a doctor.

cz.st: She isn't a nurse; she ___ a doctor.

items.rule: 주어가 she일 때 be동사는 is이고 부정은 isn't예요. 같은 주어에는 같은 be동사를 맞춰 써요.

items.good: It's cold outside today.
bad: I's cold outside today.
Its cold outside today.
It'is cold outside today.
items.rule: it is는 it's로 줄여 쓰고 아포스트로피(')가 들어가요. its는 '그것의'라는 뜻이라서 여기서는 맞지 않아요.

items.good: We're ready for the test.
bad: We's ready for the test.
We'm ready for the test.
Were ready for the test.
items.rule: we are는 we're로 줄여 써요. 아포스트로피를 빼면 were(과거형)가 돼요.

items.good: Are you a new member of the club?
bad: Do you are a new member of the club?
Is you a new member of the club?
Am you a new member of the club?

cz.st: ___ you a new member of the club?

items.rule: be동사 의문문은 be동사를 주어 앞으로 보내요. you에는 are를 써요.

items.good: Is your sister at the park?
bad: Does your sister at the park?
Are your sister at the park?
Your sister at the park is?
items.rule: be동사 의문문은 'Is + 단수 주어 ~?' 형태예요. 일반동사 does는 쓰지 않아요.

items.good: Am I too late for the show?
bad: Do I am too late for the show?
Is I too late for the show?
Are I too late for the show?

cz.st: ___ I too late for the show?

items.rule: 주어 I의 의문문은 Am I ~? 형태예요.

items.good: Where is my blue pen?
bad: Where my blue pen is?
Where are my blue pen?
Where does my blue pen?
items.rule: 의문사 의문문은 '의문사 + be동사 + 주어' 순서예요. 주어 my blue pen이 단수이므로 is를 써요.

items.good: How old are your grandparents?
bad: How old is your grandparents?
How old your grandparents are?
How old do your grandparents?
items.rule: 주어 your grandparents가 복수이므로 are를 써요. 순서는 'How old + be동사 + 주어?'예요.

items.good: What time is the concert tonight?
bad: What time the concert is tonight?
What time are the concert tonight?
What time does the concert tonight?
items.rule: 시각은 What time is ~?로 물어요. 주어 the concert가 단수이므로 is를 써요.

items.good: Who is that girl in the red coat?
items.ko: 빨간 코트를 입은 저 여자아이는 누구예요?
bad: Who are that girl in the red coat?
Who that girl is in the red coat?
Who be that girl in the red coat?

cz.st: Who ___ that girl in the red coat?

items.rule: Who is ~?는 '~는 누구인가요?'예요. 주어 that girl이 단수이므로 is를 써요.

items.good: Why are you so happy today?
bad: Why you are so happy today?
Why is you so happy today?
Why do you so happy today?
items.rule: 의문사 뒤에서는 be동사가 주어 앞에 와요. you에는 are를 써요.

items.good: Which bag is yours?
bad: Which bag are yours?
Which bag yours is?
Which bag does yours?
items.rule: Which bag은 단수 주어이므로 is와 함께 써요.

items.good: I was sick yesterday.
bad: I were sick yesterday.
I am sick yesterday.
I was be sick yesterday.
items.rule: yesterday처럼 과거를 나타내는 말이 있으면 be동사의 과거형을 써요. I의 과거형은 was예요.

items.good: The boys were tired after the game.
bad: The boys was tired after the game.
The boys is tired after the game.
The boys be tired after the game.

cz.st: The boys ___ tired after the game.

items.rule: 복수 주어의 be동사 과거형은 were예요.

items.good: We weren't at school last Monday.
bad: We wasn't at school last Monday.
We aren't at school last Monday.
We didn't at school last Monday.
items.rule: were not의 줄임말은 weren't예요. last Monday는 과거를 나타내요.

items.good: Was the movie interesting?
bad: Were the movie interesting?
Did the movie interesting?
Was the movie interested?
items.rule: 과거의 일을 물을 때는 Was/Were를 주어 앞에 써요. the movie는 단수이므로 Was예요.

items.good: Were you at the station at noon?
bad: Was you at the station at noon?
Did you at the station at noon?
Were you be at the station at noon?

cz.st: ___ you at the station at noon?

items.rule: you의 be동사 과거형은 were예요. 'Were + 주어 ~?'로 물어요.

items.good: Where were you last night?
bad: Where was you last night?
Where you were last night?
Where did you last night?
items.rule: 의문사 뒤의 be동사 과거형: you에는 were를 써요.

items.good: It was rainy two days ago.
bad: It were rainy two days ago.
It is rainy two days ago.
It be rainy two days ago.
items.rule: two days ago처럼 과거를 나타내는 말과 함께 쓰면 it의 be동사는 was예요.

items.good: There was a big tree here ten years ago.
items.ko: 십 년 전에는 여기에 큰 나무가 있었어요.
bad: There were a big tree here ten years ago.
There is a big tree here ten years ago.
There be a big tree here ten years ago.

cz.st: There ___ a big tree here ten years ago.

items.rule: 과거의 '~이 있었다'는 단수 명사에는 There was, 복수 명사에는 There were를 써요.

items.good: There were many people at the festival last weekend.
bad: There was many people at the festival last weekend.
There is many people at the festival last weekend.
There be many people at the festival last weekend.

cz.st: There ___ many people at the festival last weekend.

items.rule: many people은 복수이므로 There were를 써요. last weekend는 과거예요.

items.good: Yesterday was my birthday.
bad: Yesterday were my birthday.
Yesterday is my birthday.
Yesterday be my birthday.
items.rule: yesterday는 과거이고 주어가 단수이므로 was를 써요.

items.good: Is there a post office near here?
bad: Are there a post office near here?
Does there a post office near here?
Is there have a post office near here?

cz.st: ___ there a post office near here?

items.rule: '~이 있나요?'는 Is there + 단수 명사 ~?로 물어요.

items.good: There aren't any chairs in the room.
bad: There isn't chairs in the room.
There aren't no chairs in the room.
There don't any chairs in the room.

cz.st: There ___ any chairs in the room.

items.rule: There are의 부정은 There aren't ~예요. 부정문에서 any를 쓰고 no를 함께 쓰지 않아요.

items.good: How many students are there in your class?
items.ko: 너희 반에는 학생이 몇 명 있니?
bad: How many students there are in your class?
How many students are in there your class?
How many students do there in your class?

cz.st: How many students ___ there in your class?

items.rule: 'How many + 복수 명사 + are there ~?'로 개수를 물어요.

items.good: My cousin is interested in space.
bad: My cousin is interesting in space.
My cousin is interest in space.
My cousin is interested on space.
items.rule: interested는 '관심 있는', interesting은 '흥미로운'이에요. 사람이 관심을 갖는다고 할 때는 be interested in을 써요.

items.good: My dad is never late for work.
bad: My dad is never be late for work.
My dad are never late for work.
My dad does never late for work.

cz.st: My dad ___ never late for work.

items.rule: never 같은 빈도 부사는 be동사 뒤에 와요: is never late.

items.good: Be quiet in the library, please.
bad: Are quiet in the library, please.
Is quiet in the library, please.
Do quiet in the library, please.
items.rule: 명령문은 동사원형으로 시작해요. be동사의 원형은 be예요.

items.good: Don't be late for class.
bad: Don't late for class.
Don't are late for class.
Not be late for class.
items.rule: 부정 명령문은 Don't + 동사원형이에요. be동사의 원형 be를 써요.

items.good: Mina is taller than her brother.
bad: Mina are taller than her brother.
Mina is tallest than her brother.
Mina be taller than her brother.
items.rule: 비교하는 문장에서도 주어에 맞는 be동사를 써요. Mina는 단수이므로 is예요.

items.good: The cookies on the table are for you.
items.ko: 탁자 위의 쿠키는 너를 위한 거야.
bad: The cookies on the table is for you.
The cookies on the table am for you.
The cookies on the table be for you.

cz.st: The cookies on the table ___ for you.

items.rule: 주어는 cookies(복수)이고 on the table은 꾸며 주는 말이에요. 그래서 are를 써요.

items.good: Are these your keys?
bad: Is these your keys?
Are this your keys?
Do these your keys?
items.rule: these는 복수이므로 Are these ~?로 물어요.

items.good: Those are my grandfather's glasses.
bad: Those is my grandfather's glasses.
That are my grandfather's glasses.
Those am my grandfather's glasses.
items.rule: 복수 are 앞에는 복수 지시어 those를 써요. that과 this는 단수예요.

items.good: My little brother is five years old.
bad: My little brother has five years old.
My little brother is five year old.
My little brother are five years old.

cz.st: My little brother ___ five years old.

items.rule: 나이는 be동사로 말해요: He is five years old. have를 쓰지 않아요.

items.good: The lights were off when we got home.
items.ko: 우리가 집에 왔을 때 불이 꺼져 있었어요.
bad: The lights was off when we got home.
The lights is off when we got home.
The lights be off when we got home.

cz.st: The lights ___ off when we got home.

items.rule: lights는 복수이고 when we got home은 과거이므로 were를 써요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "My grandparents ___ in Busan now."
items.why: grandparents는 복수 주어이므로 are를 써요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "The festival ___ great last night."
items.why: last night은 과거이고 festival은 단수이므로 was를 써요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "A bottle of water ___ on the desk."
items.why: 주어의 중심은 a bottle(단수)이므로 is를 써요.

items.q:
Complete the dialogue.
A: Is Daniel your cousin?
B: No, ___.
items.why: Is ~?로 물으면 be동사로 답해요. 부정의 짧은 답은 'No, he isn't.'예요.

items.q:
Complete the dialogue.
A: Are you and Hana in the same class?
B: Yes, ___.
items.why: you and Hana를 한 말로 받으면 we가 되고, 대답은 'Yes, we are.'예요.

items.q:
Complete the dialogue.
A: Was the test difficult?
B: Yes, ___.
items.why: Was ~?로 물었으므로 'Yes, it was.'로 답해요.

items.q:
Complete the dialogue.
A: Were your parents at the concert?
B: No, ___.
items.why: Were ~?의 부정 대답은 'No, they weren't.'예요.

items.q:
Complete the dialogue.
A: Am I late?
B: No, ___.
items.why: 질문의 I는 대답에서 you가 되고, you에는 aren't를 써요.

items.q: Which question has the answer "She is my aunt."?
items.why: '누구인지'를 묻는 질문은 Who is ~?예요.

items.q: Choose the best answer to "How old is your dog?"
items.why: How old ~?는 나이를 묻는 질문이에요.

items.q: Which question has the answer "They are in the kitchen."?
items.why: 장소를 말하는 대답에는 Where ~?로 물어요.

items.q: Which question has the answer "Her name is Yuna."?
items.why: 이름은 What is ~ name?으로 물어요.

items.q: Choose the fix for this sentence. "Mina and I is in the art club."
items.why: Mina and I는 두 사람이므로 복수 are를 써요.

items.q: Choose the fix for this sentence. "Does your brother a high school student?"
items.why: be동사 문장의 의문문은 Is로 시작해요. does는 일반동사에 써요.

items.q: Choose the fix for this sentence. "We was very tired after the long hike."
items.why: we의 과거형 be동사는 were예요.

items.q: Choose the fix for this sentence. "There is five books on the shelf."
items.why: five books는 복수이므로 There are를 써요.

items.q: Which is the correct form of "She not is a teacher."?
items.why: be동사 부정문은 'be동사 + not' 순서예요.

items.q: What does 's stand for in "She's at the museum"?
items.why: She's는 She is의 줄임말이에요.

items.q: Which word is the short form of "are not"?
items.why: are not의 줄임말은 aren't예요.

items.q: Which is the full form of "weren't"?
items.why: weren't는 were not의 줄임말이에요.

items.q: What is the full form of "I'm"?
items.why: I'm은 I am의 줄임말이에요.

items.q: Which sentence uses the short form of "it is" correctly?
items.why: it is는 it's로 줄이고 아포스트로피는 s 앞에 한 번만 써요.

items.q: Which sentence uses "they're" correctly?
items.why: they're는 they are의 줄임말이에요. 소유를 나타내는 말은 their예요.

items.q: Which English sentence matches "그 책들은 책상 위에 있어요."?
o: The books are on the desk.
The books is on the desk.
The books are in the desk.
The books be on the desk.
items.why: books는 복수이므로 are를 쓰고, '위에'는 on이에요.

items.q: Which English sentence matches "우리는 어제 집에 없었어요."?
items.why: yesterday가 있으므로 과거형이고, we에는 weren't를 써요.

items.q: Which English sentence matches "당신은 한국에서 왔나요?"?
items.why: be동사 의문문은 Are you ~?예요.

items.q: Which English sentence matches "저 소년은 내 남동생이 아니에요."?
o: That boy not is my brother.
That boy does not my brother.
Those boy are not my brother.
That boy is not my brother.
items.why: 단수 that boy에는 is not을 써요.

items.q: Choose the time expression that fits. "My uncle was in Jeju ___."
items.why: was는 과거에 쓰므로 과거를 나타내는 말(two years ago)과 어울려요.

items.q: Choose the time word that fits. "We are in the school gym ___."
items.why: are는 현재형이므로 지금을 나타내는 now와 어울려요.

items.q: Choose the correct pair. "I ___ at the dentist yesterday, but my sister ___ there today."
items.why: yesterday는 과거(was), today는 현재이고 my sister는 단수(is)예요.

items.q: Choose the correct pair. "___ the students in the gym? Yes, they ___."
items.why: 복수 주어 the students에는 Are로 묻고 they are로 답해요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "Last summer, we ___ in Japan for a week."
items.why: Last summer는 과거이고 we의 과거형은 were예요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "Where ___ the keys? I can't find them."
items.why: the keys는 복수이므로 are를 써요.

items.q: Choose the best phrase. "___ a cat on the roof."
items.why: 단수 명사 a cat에는 There is를 써요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "How many eggs ___ there in the fridge?"
items.why: How many eggs 뒤에는 복수 be동사 are를 써요.

items.q: Which sentence correctly says that one library is near the park?
o: There are a library near the park.
There is a library near the park.
There have a library near the park.
It has a library near the park.
items.why: 단수 명사 앞에는 There is를 써요. 'have'는 '있다'는 뜻의 There 구문에 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: Choose the best answer to "Is there a bakery on this street?"
items.why: Is there ~?에는 'Yes, there is.'로 답해요.

items.q: Choose the best answer to "Are there any buses to the airport at night?"
items.why: Are there ~?에는 'No, there aren't.'로 답해요.

items.q: You point at two pens on your desk. Which sentence is best?
items.why: 가까이 있는 복수의 것은 these를 쓰고 be동사는 are예요.

items.q: You point at a bird in a far tree. Which sentence is best?
items.why: 멀리 있는 단수는 that을 쓰고 be동사는 is예요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "___ are my new neighbors over there."
items.why: over there(저쪽)와 복수 are에는 those를 써요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "___ careful on the ice, Sam."
items.why: 명령문은 동사원형으로 시작하므로 Be를 써요.

items.q: Choose the best phrase. "___ noisy in the museum."
items.why: 부정 명령문은 Don't + 동사원형(be)이에요.

items.q: Which phrase correctly completes "My mom is ___"?
items.why: 직업 앞에는 a/an을 붙이고 단수로 말해요.

items.q: Which word is correct? "The lesson was ___."
items.why: 수업이 '지루하게 만드는' 것이므로 boring을 써요. 사람이 지루함을 느낄 때는 bored를 써요.

items.q: Which question asks the price of a notebook?
items.why: 가격은 How much ~?로 물어요.

items.q:
Choose the best reply.
A: What's the weather like today?
B: ___
items.why: 날씨를 묻는 질문에는 날씨로 답해요.

items.q:
Choose the best reply.
A: What time is the soccer game?
B: ___
items.why: What time ~?에는 시각으로 답해요.

items.q:
Choose the best reply.
A: Who is your homeroom teacher?
B: ___
items.why: Who ~?에는 사람 이름으로 답해요.

items.q:
Choose the best reply.
A: How is your grandmother today?
B: ___
items.why: How is ~?는 상태를 물어요. 건강 상태로 답하는 것이 알맞아요.

items.q: Which word is NOT a form of the verb be?
items.why: am, are, is는 be동사의 형태예요. do는 일반동사예요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "The twins ___ born in March."
items.why: 주어 the twins가 복수이고 태어난 일은 과거이므로 were를 써요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "My sister and I ___ the same age."
items.why: My sister and I는 복수 주어이므로 are를 써요.

items.q: Choose the best word. "The weather ___ terrible on Saturday, so we stayed home."
items.why: stayed가 과거이므로 be동사도 과거형 was를 써요.

items.q: Complete the sentences. "How ___ your weekend? It ___ great."
items.why: weekend는 단수이므로 was를 쓰고, it의 과거형도 was예요.

items.q:
Complete the dialogue.
A: Are you hungry?
B: No, I ___. I'm full.
items.why: Are you ~?에는 'No, I am not.'으로 답해요.

items.title: My New School
items.text: Today is my first day at a new school. I am nervous, but my classmates are very friendly. My homeroom teacher, Ms. Oh, is kind and funny. She is also our English teacher. The classroom is big and bright, and there are thirty desks in it. My desk is next to the window. At lunch, I am with two girls named Yuri and Soyeon. They are in the cooking club, and they are happy to see a new face. I am not worried now. I think this school is going to be great.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: A teacher who joins the cooking club
A big classroom with thirty desks
A girl who changes her homeroom class
A student's first day at a new school
qs.why: 처음 학교에 간 날의 경험과 기분을 이야기하는 글이에요.

qs.q: Who is the English teacher?
qs.why: 'She is also our English teacher.'에서 She는 Ms. Oh예요.

qs.q: Where is the writer's desk?
qs.why: 'My desk is next to the window.'라고 했어요.

qs.q: How does the writer feel at the end?
qs.why: 마지막에 걱정하지 않고 학교가 멋질 것이라고 생각해요.

qs.q: In the passage, who does "they" in "they are happy to see a new face" refer to?
qs.why: 앞 문장에서 cooking club에 있는 두 소녀를 말해요.

items.title: Lost and Found
items.text:
Ben: Excuse me. Is this the lost and found?
Clerk: Yes, it is. Can I help you?
Ben: I think my jacket is here. It was on a bench in the park yesterday.
Clerk: What color is it?
Ben: It's dark green, and there are two big pockets.
Clerk: Hmm. Here are three jackets. Are they yours?
Ben: No, the first one is blue, and the other two are too small. Wait, that one on the chair is mine!
Clerk: Great. Is your name inside?
Ben: Yes, it is. Look, Ben Park.
Clerk: Perfect. Here you are.

qs.q: Where does this conversation take place?
o: At a lost and found office
qs.why: Ben이 'Is this the lost and found?'라고 물어요.

qs.q: Where was Ben's jacket yesterday?
o: On a bus to the city
On a bench in the park
qs.why: 'It was on a bench in the park yesterday.'라고 말해요.

qs.q: What color is Ben's jacket?
qs.why: Ben이 'It's dark green'이라고 말해요.

qs.q: How does Ben show that the jacket is his?
o: He shows a photo of the jacket
His name is written inside it
He tells the clerk his address
qs.why: 이름이 안쪽에 있다고 확인하고 Ben Park을 보여 줘요.

items.title: A Rainy Saturday
items.text: Last Saturday was rainy, so my brother and I were at home all day. At first we were bored. The TV was broken, and our books were at school. Then our grandmother was in the kitchen, and she said, "Let's make dumplings!" Soon the kitchen was full of flour and laughter. My brother was terrible at folding them, but he was the best at eating them. By evening, the rain was gone. The dumplings were delicious, and we were not bored anymore.

qs.q: Why were the children at home last Saturday?
qs.why: 첫 문장에서 토요일에 비가 와서 집에 있었다고 해요.

qs.q: What does "bored" most likely mean in the passage?
o: Tired of having nothing to do
qs.why: TV가 고장 나고 책도 없어서 할 일이 없는 상태예요.

qs.q: Who was the best at eating dumplings?
qs.why: 'he was the best at eating them'에서 he는 형제예요.

qs.q: What happened after the grandmother suggested making dumplings?
o: The kitchen became busy and messy
qs.why: 곧 부엌이 밀가루와 웃음으로 가득 찼다고 해요.

qs.q: Which statement is true?
o: The brother was good at folding
The TV worked well all day
The writer stayed bored until night
qs.why: 마지막 문장에서 dumplings were delicious라고 해요.

items.title: Join the Science Club
items.text: Join the Science Club! Our club meets in Room 204 every Wednesday after school. The room is next to the library, so it is easy to find. Our teacher, Mr. Han, is an expert on volcanoes, and he is very patient with beginners. You are not required to be good at science. Everyone is welcome! Please bring a notebook and a pen. The first meeting is free, but the materials for later meetings are 2,000 won each. Are you curious? Come and see us on Wednesday!

qs.q: Why was this notice written?
o: To invite students to join a club
To ask for money for a trip
To introduce a new school building
qs.why: Join the Science Club!으로 시작하며 가입을 권하는 글이에요.

qs.q: When does the club meet?
qs.why: every Wednesday after school이라고 해요.

qs.q: How can students find the room?
o: It is next to the library
It is across from the gym
qs.why: 'The room is next to the library'라고 해요.

qs.q: Which is true about the first meeting?
o: Students must be good at science
It is held in the library
qs.why: 첫 모임은 free(무료)라고 해요.

qs.q: What kind of teacher is Mr. Han?
qs.why: he is very patient with beginners라고 해요.

items.title: My Pet Hamster
items.text: I have a pet hamster. His name is Mochi. He is small and round, and his fur is soft and brown. Mochi is awake at night, so he is very sleepy in the morning. His favorite foods are sunflower seeds and carrots. His cage is in my room, next to my desk. There are two wheels and a little house in it. My mom is not a big fan of hamsters, but she is kind to Mochi. I am very happy with my small friend.

qs.q: When is Mochi active?
qs.why: Mochi is awake at night라고 해요.

qs.q: Where is Mochi's cage?
qs.why: His cage is in my room이라고 해요.

qs.q: What does "awake" mean in the passage?
qs.why: 밤에 깨어 있어서 아침에 졸리다는 흐름이에요.

qs.q: How does the writer's mom feel about hamsters?
o: She is not very fond of them
She wants to get another one
She is afraid of all pets
She likes them more than the writer does
qs.why: not a big fan은 '별로 좋아하지 않는다'는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What is the best title for the passage?
qs.why: 글 전체가 햄스터를 소개하고 있어요.

items.title: Grandpa's Village
items.text: Last summer, my family was in my grandfather's village for two weeks. The village is small and quiet. There are only about forty houses, and the mountains are all around it. Every morning, the air was cool and fresh. Grandpa's garden was full of tomatoes and corn. My cousins were there too, so we were never bored. We were in the river almost every afternoon. The water was cold, but it was fun. I am sad now because summer is over, but my memories are very happy.

qs.q: How long was the writer's family in the village?
qs.why: for two weeks라고 해요.

qs.q: What was in Grandpa's garden?
qs.why: garden was full of tomatoes and corn이라고 해요.

qs.q: Why does the writer feel sad now?
qs.why: because summer is over라고 해요.

qs.q: Which sentence is NOT true about the village?
qs.why: 마을은 작고 조용하다고 했어요.

items.title: Planning a Party
items.text:
Jisu: Hi, Tom. Is your birthday this Friday?
Tom: No, it isn't. It's next Friday.
Jisu: Oh, I'm sorry. Are you free that afternoon?
Tom: Yes, I am. My parents are at work, so the house is empty.
Jisu: Great! We can have a small party. Who is coming?
Tom: Minho and Sara are coming. They're my best friends.
Jisu: Is Sara allergic to nuts? Her cake can't have any.
Tom: Yes, she is. Good question! Let's make a plain chocolate cake.
Jisu: OK. I'm good at baking, so I can make it.

qs.q: When is Tom's birthday?
qs.why: Tom이 'It's next Friday.'라고 말해요.

qs.q: Why is Tom's house empty that afternoon?
o: His family is on a trip
His parents are at a party
qs.why: My parents are at work, so the house is empty라고 해요.

qs.q: Why does Jisu ask about nuts?
o: Tom asks for a nut cake
The shop has no nuts today
She wants the cake to be safe for Sara
qs.why: Sara가 견과류 알레르기가 있는지 확인하고 있어요.

qs.q: What will Jisu do for the party?
qs.why: I'm good at baking, so I can make it이라고 해요.

items.title: Our Town Library
items.text: Our town library is on Maple Street. It is open from nine to six, and it is closed on Sundays. There are three floors. The first floor is for children, and there are many picture books and soft cushions. The second floor is quiet, and there are long tables for studying. The third floor is a small cafe, but it is not open in the morning. Last month, there was a book festival, and many families were there. The library is a great place for everyone.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: A story about a book festival
Rules for studying at a cafe
A description of a town library
qs.why: 도서관의 위치, 시간, 층별 모습을 소개하는 글이에요.

qs.q: On which floor are the long study tables?
qs.why: The second floor ... long tables for studying이라고 해요.

qs.q: When is the library closed?
qs.why: closed on Sundays라고 해요.

qs.q: What was held at the library last month?
qs.why: Last month, there was a book festival이라고 해요.

qs.q: Who would most likely enjoy the first floor?
o: A young child who likes stories
A student preparing for a test
A person who wants some coffee
qs.why: 1층은 어린이를 위한 그림책 공간이에요.

items.title: An Email to Emma
items.text:
Hi Emma,
How are you? I am fine, but I am very busy these days. School is hard this term, and the tests are every week. Yesterday I was late for science class because the bus was slow. My teacher was not angry, but I felt bad about it. My weekend is free, so I am ready to relax. Are you free on Saturday? The new park is open, and the lake there is beautiful. Please write back soon!
Your friend,
Dana

qs.q: Why does Dana write this email?
o: To say sorry for missing a test
To tell Emma about a new school
To ask for help with homework
To ask Emma about weekend plans
qs.why: 토요일에 시간이 되는지 묻고 답장을 부탁해요.

qs.q: Why was Dana late for science class?
qs.why: because the bus was slow라고 해요.

qs.q: How did Dana feel about being late?
o: She felt angry at the teacher
qs.why: I felt bad about it라고 해요.

qs.q: What new place does Dana mention?
qs.why: The new park is open, and the lake there is beautiful이라고 해요.

qs.q: Which is true about Dana's weekend?
o: It is spent at the lake
qs.why: My weekend is free라고 해요.

items.title: The Twins Next Door
items.text: Hana and Dani are twins, but they are very different. Hana is tall and quiet. She is a member of the library club, and her favorite place is the reading room. Dani is short and loud. He is on the school soccer team, and he is always on the field after class. They are both good students, but their hobbies are not the same. Their mother is a nurse, and their father is a bus driver. On weekends, they are together at their grandmother's house. There, they are both happy.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
qs.why: 쌍둥이의 성격과 취미가 서로 다르다는 내용이에요.

qs.q: What does Dani do after class?
o: He spends time on the soccer field
He studies in the reading room
He helps at the library club
qs.why: he is always on the field after class라고 해요.

qs.q: In the passage, "loud" describes Dani as someone who is ___.
qs.why: Hana가 조용하다는 것과 대비되어 '시끄럽고 활발한' 사람을 말해요.

qs.q: What is the twins' father's job?
qs.why: their father is a bus driver라고 해요.

qs.q: Where are the twins together on weekends?
qs.why: On weekends, they are together at their grandmother's house라고 해요.

items.ex: Minho is absent from school today.
I was nervous before my first piano show.
items.exko: 나는 첫 피아노 공연 전에 긴장했어요.

items.ex: My neighbors are always polite to children.
items.exko: 우리 이웃들은 아이들에게 항상 예의 바르게 대해요.
